decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank window or other glazed openings shall be formed in the north west side-facing wall of the extensions nor in either side elevation of the outbuilding hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall remain incidental to the enjoyment of the property 92 Arnold Crescent and for no other purpose including the provision of living accommodation or for any business use.
description: Erection of a single storey rear, two-storey side extension, rear roof extension and a games room/store to rear garden of the house.
